doc.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Recording for Chess and Argo; race records
summary: Moody's group recorded for Chess and Argo, labels seen as rhythm and blues, in the era of race records.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: You did a lot -- quite a lot of recording with that particular -­
Yep! Yeah. We did a lot for Chess, Chess Records and Argo.
Which was really, I guess, more of a blues and rhythm and blues label than actually a label that was considered a jazz label at the time.
Right! Right. It was a rhythm and blues -- but don't forget, in those days, too, they had race records.
Right, and I'd like for you to talk a little bit about that.
